title: [Working title]
premise: [2-3 sentences: who the protagonists are, what brings them together, what each wants from the arrangement, and the central irony or collision that makes the story work]
central_question: [The question the story asks. Stated as a question. Should feel felt rather than declared.]
reader_promise: [1-2 spoiler-light sentences: what emotional and genre experience is promised, what tension sustains the read, and what satisfaction the ending owes]
story_answer: [1-2 spoiler-containing sentences: how the protagonist's final choice and the story outcome answer the central question]

protagonists.heroine: [Name, age, origin, personality, what she wants, what she doesn't know she needs, what makes her compelling. 3-5 sentences in a distinctive register that already sounds like her.]
protagonists.hero: [Name, age, origin, personality, what he wants, what he doesn't know he needs, what makes him compelling. 3-5 sentences. The contrast with the heroine should be visible in the register.]

mechanism.how_they_meet: [The scene, the circumstances, what each notices first about the other]
mechanism.how_the_deal_forms: [What transaction or arrangement brings them into proximity. What each believes they are getting.]
mechanism.his_real_reason: [What he isn't admitting to himself about why he took her / made the deal / stayed]

act_1.shape: [What happens across the first act: the game they play, what each is running, what is withheld, what the reader sees that the characters don't. 3-5 sentences.]
act_1.ends_with: [State of play at the act break: what each knows, has, and wants. What has shifted without either admitting it. 1-2 sentences.]

act_2.shape: [What happens across the second act: escalation, entry into the antagonist's world, the deepening. What the cast does to each other. 3-5 sentences.]
act_2.midpoint: [The specific event that reframes everything. What shifts and why it can't be undone. 1-2 sentences.]
act_2.ends_with: [State of play at the act break. What choice has been made or forced. 1-2 sentences.]

act_3.shape: [What happens in the final act: the confrontation, the takedown, the resolution. How the antagonist falls. What each protagonist chooses. 3-5 sentences.]
act_3.payoff: [The concrete climax or resolution that fulfills the reader promise and demonstrates the story answer. 1-2 sentences.]
act_3.ends_with: [The final image or state. Where each character is. What the last line of the book feels like. 1-2 sentences.]

open_threads: [Unresolved element that sits at the edge of resolution — a character not found, a threat not destroyed, a question not answered]
